hero.title: Smile, you're in good hands.
hero.subtitle: Gentle, unhurried dental care for kids, grown-ups and everyone who's a little nervous about the dentist. We'll explain everything and go at your pace.

services.title: How we can help
services.subtitle: From your six-monthly check-up to a brand-new smile. Tap a card to learn more.
services.placeholderNote: Service list to be confirmed by the clinic.

checkups.title: Check-ups & cleaning
checkups.short: A friendly once-over and a fresh, polished feeling.
checkups.detail: We check your teeth, gums and bite, take X-rays only when they're needed, and gently remove plaque and tartar. You'll leave with a fresh smile and simple tips for keeping it that way.

whitening.title: Teeth whitening
whitening.detail: After a quick check that whitening suits your teeth, we'll talk through in-clinic and take-home options so you get a natural-looking result that's kind to your enamel.

fillings.title: Fillings
fillings.short: Tooth-coloured repairs that blend right in.
fillings.detail: Small cavities are repaired with tooth-coloured composite material, matched to your shade. We numb the area first and check in with you throughout.

rootCanal.title: Root canal treatment
rootCanal.detail: When the inside of a tooth is infected, a root canal treatment removes the infection and saves the tooth. Modern techniques and good anaesthetic make it far more comfortable than its reputation.

crowns.title: Crowns & bridges
crowns.detail: Crowns protect weak or heavily filled teeth, and bridges replace a missing tooth by anchoring to its neighbours. We'll help you choose the right material and shade.

implants.title: Dental implants
implants.short: A long-lasting way to replace missing teeth.
implants.detail: An implant is a small titanium post that acts like a tooth root and supports a natural-looking crown. We'll plan every step with you and explain timings and costs before we start.

cosmetic.title: Cosmetic dentistry
cosmetic.detail: From bonding chipped edges to veneers and smile makeovers, we'll listen to what you'd like to change and suggest options that look like you, only brighter.

kids.title: Children's dentistry
kids.short: Fun, gentle visits that build happy habits.
kids.detail: We keep children's visits short, playful and positive, with plenty of praise. Check-ups, fluoride, fissure sealants and lots of brushing tips for parents too.

emergency.title: Dental emergencies
emergency.short: Toothache or accident? Call us today.
emergency.detail: Severe pain, swelling, a broken tooth or a knocked-out tooth: call us as early as possible and we'll do our best to see you the same day during opening hours.

family.title: For the whole family
family.subtitle: Little ones, big ones and everyone in between.
family.kidsText: We turn the first visits into a little adventure: a ride in the big chair, counting teeth, a sticker at the end. No rush, no scary words.
family.nervousText: Tell us how you feel and we'll take it slowly. We explain every step before we do it, and you can raise a hand to pause at any time.
points: Raise a hand to pause, any time

items.q: What happens at my first visit?
items.a: We'll say hello, ask about your health and any worries, then do a gentle check of your teeth and gums. If X-rays are needed we'll explain why. Before anything else happens, we talk you through what we found and your options. No surprises.

items.q: From what age should my child see a dentist?
items.a: We recommend a first visit around your child's first birthday, or when the first teeth appear. Early, relaxed visits help children feel at home at the dentist.
[confirm] We accept cash and card. We'll always give you a clear cost estimate before treatment. Please ask us about payment for larger treatment plans and about insurance.

items.q: What should I do in a dental emergency?
items.a: Call us on +357 26 937970 as early as possible. We keep time aside for emergencies and will do our best to see you the same day during opening hours. If a tooth is knocked out, keep it moist in milk and call straight away.
[confirm] Yes, there is street parking close to the clinic on Nikolaou Nikolaidi Avenue. Tap "Get directions" below for a route.
[confirm] Our team speaks Greek and English, so you can ask anything in the language you're most comfortable with.

privacy.draftNote: Template text: to be reviewed by the clinic (and ideally a legal adviser) before going live.

sections.p: Theori Dental Clinic, Leoforos Nikolaou I. Nikolaidi 19, Paphos 8010, Cyprus, is the controller of the personal data collected through this website. You can contact us on +357 26 937970 [or by email: to be added].

When you send an appointment request we receive your name, phone number, email address (if given), the treatment you are interested in, your preferred date and time and any message you write. Please don't include detailed medical information in the form; we'll discuss that with you in person.
We use these details only to contact you about your appointment request (legal basis: your consent and steps prior to providing care). We do not sell your data or use it for marketing.
Appointment requests are deleted after [X months] unless you become a patient, in which case your records are kept in line with Cypriot health record regulations.
Form submissions are processed by our website hosting provider [Netlify / Formspree: confirm] on our behalf, under a data-processing agreement.
You can ask to see, correct or delete your data, withdraw consent at any time, and complain to the Commissioner for Personal Data Protection in Cyprus (dataprotection.gov.cy).
